notes: The operator's run, by their account; nothing piped or recorded, so every null is a thing not kept, not a zero. Sam ran new and share 8096 on a machine outside Dee's network; Dee joined by the https link on this machine (its stdout not kept). The TV is an LG running Jellyfin's own app from its store: the room door's address typed once — a bare IP on Dee's WiFi, not localhost, not Sam's — then Use Quick Connect, the code approved from Dee's login (the group's link, Sam's jellyfin, the room's account, apps/jellyfin/ROOM.md). Films played on the TV; the operator marks the evening a success. Not read, so not claimed: each person's clock (succeeded_in_time), the users export (accounts_created), anything a phone asked (key_prompts), any help given (assisted), playback direct or converted, the TV's name in Play on, whether the app kept the room address with room stopped. The one kept artifact is data/dee-room.log — a refusal, not a room log: join runs the node until Ctrl-C (crates/svrngs/src/cli.rs:928-931), so a room chained after it with && never started, and room run beside it was refused while join held ~/.svrngs/lock ('svrngs is already running on this computer'); room served only after join was stopped, as the dry run's harness does (apps/jellyfin/check/screen.sh:55-59). The dry run this repeats is demo/runs/b/2026-10-06/.
